The Ohio State University Hemophilia Treatment Center clinic uses 340B savings to provide a variety of services to the community including: 
- Direct patient assistance: emergency living costs, medical IDs, transportation assistance, gift cards for food assistance, wellness programs supporting patient's physical and mental wellbeing. 
- Staff Salaries.
- Medical support services provided by HTC staff (surgical planning services & treatment education services).
- Education services (patient education, staff education).
- Monthly outreach clinic (added additional clinic space). 
- Bleeding disorder specific Physical Therapy.
- Point of Care Ultrasound.
- Genetic Counseling Services.
- Pediatric HTC to Adult HTC Transition Services.
